survivors.rule: .claude/rules/sync.md — The plan log stays inside one publishable event

proposedTest.title: sync.md — The plan log stays inside one publishable event: the budget counts UTF-8 bytes, not code units

survivors.mutantOutput: publishEncrypted data = { events: all 3 events } (differs from the persisted log)

proposedTest.title: sync.md — The plan log stays inside one publishable event: the publish sends the compacted log it persists
